reference: Yesterday she bought a big mango at the market.
sk: Včera si na trhu kúpila veľké mango.
cz: Včera si na trhu koupila velké mango.
acceptable: Yesterday she bought {herself |}a {big|large} mango {at|in} the market.
She bought {herself |}a {big|large} mango {at|in} the market yesterday.
Yesterday at the market she bought {herself |}a {big|large} mango.
At the market yesterday she bought {herself |}a {big|large} mango.

mistakes.text: Yesterday she buyed a {big|large} mango at the market.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „buy“ je nepravidelné sloveso: v Past Simple patrí „bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „buy“ je nepravidelné sloveso: v Past Simple patří „bought“.

mistakes.text: Yesterday she buys a {big|large} mango at the market.
Yesterday she has bought a {big|large} mango at the market.
mistakes.feedback_sk: S „yesterday“ nepoužívaj Present Perfect, patrí tu Past Simple: „bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: S „yesterday“ nepoužívej Present Perfect, patří sem Past Simple: „bought“.

mistakes.text: Yesterday she brought a {big|large} mango at the market.
Yesterday she bought {big|large} mango at the market.
Yesterday she bought a {big|large} mango on the market.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Na trhu = „at the market“, nie „on the market“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Na trhu = „at the market“, ne „on the market“.
